title: Tighten /custom-night-sky-map hero into one primary editor CTA with a stable selector
description:
Roadmap conversion lane: GA4 shows sessions concentrated on / with zero conversions over 28 days, and Search Console shows /custom-night-sky-map with meaningful impressions but weak average position—often a symptom of unclear next-step intent. Refactor only the above-the-fold hero so there is exactly one obvious primary CTA to the map editor flow, and tag it with a stable data attribute for measurement consistency.

— proposed by briefing agent on 2026-04-21T23:57:36.634Z
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP GET https://starmapco.com/custom-night-sky-map returns 200 and the response body includes a single element matching a[data-lp-primary-cta="editor"] whose href starts with /editor (or absolute https://starmapco.com/editor).
testPlan: GET the page and parse HTML (or simple string checks) to confirm exactly one matching anchor exists in the first screenful/hero region if the template makes that easy to bound.
